title: Bali Creative Decision Model v0.1
description: Semantic decision architecture defining how an intelligent editor reasons from narrative needs to technique selection.
core_principles: Given this specific narrative moment, what should a strong Bali editor do — and why?
Need prioritization is strictly contextual with zero universal category precedence.
Visual debt heightens narrative payoff relevance without mandatory cut enforcement.
Editorial memory uses qualitative density and fatigue awareness without arbitrary fixed time windows.
Preserve Performance (HOLD with zero techniques) is a first-class positive editorial decision.
